snippet.title: SO TSM IS HIRING? HERE'S MY APPLICATION! #HIREREZZY
snippet.description:
Hey guys, just cross posting from twitter. TSM hiring so I thought I'd apply haha, I really liked this video, we're tough on DoubleLift but you can't ever discredit his legacy and how much he's given to all League of Legends fans. Will start to upload a few of my Twitter videos on YouTube for those who don't have a Twitter account.

Note: Apologies for the lack of content guys, I work in Healthcare so the corona stuff increases our workload. I hope to start doing more content soon as soon as things go back to normal.

Also next week I'll drop a video explaining why I haven't been too active, and I also want to start using YouTube videos of other things, maybe a little series where I'm in the car, but less memes more of real talk to MY community, about my thoughts about League and non related league stuff and cool things I want to share with you guys. Love the memes but also interested in doing more stuff.

Miss you all, and hope you're all doing well.
Pleblife.
